sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: In particular, Qwen3.8-Flash is the official version based on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with more production features, e.g., 1M context length by default, official built-in tools.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an experimental open-weight multimodal large language model released by Alibaba Group's Qwen team on August 26, 2026.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Open Weight Released Aug 26 2026 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an AI model released by Qwen on Wednesday, Aug 26 2026, 12 days after Qwen3.8-27B. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run. It is a 125B parameter model with a 262k token context window.
